definitions.explanation: A chemical compound containing chlorine bonded to another element or group. Chlorides are extremely common in nature and everyday life, from table salt (sodium chloride) to industrial chemicals.

examples.japanese: ⟦{食塩|しょくえん}→食塩：14675_shokuen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{塩化|えんか}ナトリウム⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧{塩化物|えんかぶつ}だ。
examples.english: Table salt is a chloride called sodium chloride.

examples.japanese: ⟦{水道水|すいどうすい}→水道水：25349_suidousui⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{微量|びりょう}→微量：12604_biryou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{塩化物|えんかぶつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{含|ふく}まれている→含む：01982_fukumu⟧。
examples.english: Tap water contains trace amounts of chlorides.

examples.japanese: {塩化物|えんかぶつ}イオン⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{濃度|のうど}→濃度：00325_noudo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{金属|きんぞく}→金属：02645_kinzoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{腐食|ふしょく}→腐食：08020_fushoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}み→進む：01225_susumu⟧やすく⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: When the concentration of chloride ions is high, corrosion of metals accelerates.

notes:
A compound of {塩化|えんか} (chlorination; chloride of) and ⟦{物|ぶつ}→〜物：28336_butsu⟧ (substance). The word {塩|えん} here refers to "salt" in the chemical sense (a compound formed from an acid and a base), not just table salt.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {塩化|えんか}ナトリウム: sodium chloride (table salt)
- {塩化|えんか}⟦カルシウム→カルシウム：10963_karushiumu⟧: calcium chloride (used as a de-icer)
- {塩化物|えんかぶつ}イオン: chloride ion
- {塩化物|えんかぶつ}⟦{濃度|のうど}→濃度：00325_noudo⟧: chloride concentration

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{塩素|えんそ}→塩素：12143_enso⟧: chlorine — the element itself, a greenish gas
- {塩酸|えんさん}: hydrochloric acid — an acid containing chlorine
- {塩類|えんるい}: salts — a broader term for chemical salts in general
